q1_comment: Abstract describes techniques and approaches to reach net zero but does not present an assessed or modeled pathway/configuration that IS climate-neutral.
q2_comment: No specific spatial areas (country, city, region) are mentioned; only global and generic references (urban informal settlements, cities).
q4_comment: While quantitative data is present (electricity 23→33 EJ, biomass 101→62 EJ) and modeling is mentioned as a technique, it is unclear whether actual quantitative modeling/scenario analysis was conducted to generate climate-neutral pathways.
